svg.title: REMAKE — all layers
svg.desc: 36-key REMAKE with Miryoku sublayers, QWERTY and existing home-row mods. Staggered columns and physical thumbs in typing orientation. Hold legends and active-thumb tints; dashes are disabled. Media RGB positions are unbound.
svg.metadata: keyboard.toml sha256: 50c236001e1a011c3956fbb2d727f86c26b12d005724fe02f1d3a627707cac5a; palette: Modus Operandi, Protesilaos Stavrou, 20261015.953 (6272f81ae3fe); schematic key placement.
svg.text: 36 keys · three thumbs per hand · US symbol legends
Tap: large legend · Hold: colored lower legend · ▽ transparent · — disabled

g.text: QWERTY · familiar home-row mods · tap thumbs or hold for a layer
Hold left-center Enter · navigation and editing on the right
Hold left-inner Tab · pointer, wheel and buttons on the right
Hold left-outer Escape · media and BT0–BT3 · RGB positions unbound
Hold right-center Space · numpad and punctuation on the left
Hold right-inner Backspace · shifted Num symbols on the left
Hold right-outer Delete · function keys and system keys on the left

svg.text: Media bottom row: USB/BLE · BT0 · BT1 · BT2 · BT3. No RGB or external-power bindings.
Caps Word: hold Enter/Nav + H. Bootloader: hold any layer thumb + double-tap same-hand Q/P.
QWERTY now; Graphite later. Inner thumbs face the controller; Enter and Space stay centered.
